`insert` accepts a list of row dicts as the `source` positional arg, which lets both rows be added in a single call.

```python
import pixeltable as pxt

pxt.create_dir('demo', if_exists='ignore')

films = pxt.create_table(
    'demo.films',
    {'title': pxt.String, 'year': pxt.Int, 'revenue': pxt.Float},
    if_exists='replace',
)

films.insert([
    {'title': 'Jaws', 'year': 1975, 'revenue': 470.7},
    {'title': 'Alien', 'year': 1979, 'revenue': 184.7},
])
```
